description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling operations related to saved searches such as updating, saving, deleting, and requesting saved search configurations. It manages user interactions with saved search configurations via request parameters and interfaces with the SavedSearch bean for data manipulation.

classes.name: SavedSearch
classes.description: A bean representing the saved search data, used for creating, updating, and deleting saved searches.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the saving of a saved search configuration, with options for creating or updating saved searches.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a saved search based on the given identifier.

methods.name: returnSavedSearch
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a saved search by its identifier, possibly controlling its display state.
